title: New F1 driver Colapinto shows off power of Argentina's 'unicorns'
summary: New Formula 1 driver Franco Colapinto is being backed by Argentinian "unicorns" Globant and Mercado Libre, showcasing a new era of sponsorship by digital native companies. Bizarrap, a superstar DJ, played a crucial role in securing this funding, shifting sponsorship to active partnerships where tech firms like Globant provide services to F1 teams. This collaboration highlights the growing influence of Latin American tech talent and companies in global sports.

title: ODP Corp. develops AI assistant for Office Depot, Office Max associates
summary: ODP Corporation has integrated a generative AI tool, the ODP Personal Assistant, across its Office Depot and OfficeMax stores to help associates provide faster and more accurate customer service. The internal AI tool, which leverages the same technology as ChatGPT, was expanded to include more comprehensive knowledge bases after a successful launch in February 2023. This initiative positions ODP alongside other major retailers like Walmart, Target, Amazon, and Tractor Supply, which are also deploying AI to streamline operations and enhance customer and employee experiences.

title: Tech Moves: F5 chief product officer Kara Sprague named CEO at security company HackerOne
summary: Kara Sprague, chief product officer at F5, has been named CEO of cybersecurity company HackerOne, effective November 4th. Her departure prompted F5 to announce several executive changes, including promotions for Tom Fountain, Chad Whalen, and Kunal Anand. The article also covers other significant "Tech Moves" in the Pacific Northwest tech community, including Taimur Rashid's return to AWS and Michelle Seitz joining the Fred Hutch Cancer Center board.

title: Global data center industry to emit 2.5 billion tons of CO2 through 2030, Morgan Stanley says
summary: The global data center industry is projected to emit approximately 2.5 billion metric tons of CO2-equivalent emissions by 2030, according to Morgan Stanley research. This surge is driven by hyperscalers like Google, Microsoft, Meta, and Amazon expanding AI and cloud computing. The emissions are expected to accelerate investments in decarbonization solutions, clean power, and green building materials, as tech companies strive to meet climate pledges.

title: Skift Power Rankings: Ariane Gorin
summary: Ariane Gorin, the new CEO of Expedia Group, is focused on global expansion, leveraging her international background to grow the company's presence in markets like Japan and Scandinavia. She faces key challenges including stabilizing the One Key loyalty program and addressing issues with Vrbo. Gorin's leadership marks a period of strategic change as she aims to make Expedia a more globally integrated brand.

title: Virginia wrestles with growing data center wait times
summary: Virginia, the world's largest data center market, is facing significant delays in connecting new data centers to the energy grid, with wait times extending up to seven years. This issue is primarily due to the increasing volume and size of requests from energy-intensive data facilities, straining Dominion Energy's infrastructure. Governor Glenn Youngkin's administration is actively seeking solutions to ensure an affordable, reliable, and abundant energy grid while addressing developer concerns about project uncertainty.

title: News Belgium's Bpost will boost logistics ambitions with Staci takeover
summary: Belgian postal service provider Bpost announced a planned €1.3bn acquisition of French logistics firm Staci to transform its business model and address changing dynamics in last-mile delivery. The move aims to diversify Bpost's portfolio and strengthen its position as an international third-party logistics provider, with the deal expected to close in October pending regulatory approval. Bpost, which has faced declining profit margins, sees this as a major step in its transformation journey and is also seeking further takeover opportunities.

title: How Nvidia doubled earnings, lost almost $300 billion in value and shook the stock market
summary: Nvidia experienced a significant stock market shake-up, losing almost $300 billion in value in a single day, despite having doubled its earnings. This downturn is attributed to growing fears of an economic slowdown and renewed skepticism about the immediate payoff from AI investments, causing broader market indexes to also fall. Analysts highlight Nvidia's dependence on continued massive AI investments from major tech companies and warn of stock volatility.

title: IBM CEO: We Listen to What Israel and Saudi Arabia Consider “Correct Behavior”
summary: IBM CEO Arvind Krishna addressed employee concerns regarding the company's ties to the Israeli military, stating that IBM's foreign business practices are guided by the desires of the governments in the countries where they operate, including Israel and Saudi Arabia. This response, which drew comparisons to IBM's historical dealings with apartheid South Africa and Nazi Germany, has fueled greater consternation among employees who worry business interests override ethical considerations. Krishna also claimed IBM wouldn't build offensive weapons, not due to moral objections but because the company lacks internal guardrails to judge such technology.

title: State Street SPDR Portfolio S&P 500 ETF
summary: This article provides a detailed profile of the State Street SPDR Portfolio S&P 500 ETF (SPYM), including its current price, dividend information, expense ratio, holdings, performance metrics, and ESG scores. The ETF tracks Large Cap Blend Equities with an expense ratio of 0.02% and has significant assets under management. It also compares SPYM with alternative ETFs in the same category and segment.

title: Inside The Everett, downtown Nashville's new luxury apartment tower
summary: Developers have released new renderings for The Everett, a luxury apartment tower slated to open in December within Nashville Yards. The tower will feature 361 one- and two-bedroom units and offer a range of high-end amenities like a resort-style pool, spa, and game room. The Everett is part of the larger Nashville Yards mixed-use development, which includes a Grand Hyatt hotel, a concert hall, retail, and office spaces.

title: Breakingviews - Blackstone $16 bln AI deal borrows from SPAC boom
summary: Blackstone's $16.1 billion acquisition of data center operator AirTrunk uses valuation methods reminiscent of the SPAC boom, incorporating "run-rate EBITDA" which includes future client commitments and capital expenditure for committed projects to justify the deal's size. While these techniques inflate the enterprise value significantly compared to traditional metrics, they enable the sellers to achieve a much higher valuation. A standard valuation method would show an 87 times EBITDA multiple, which is a figure difficult for any buyer to state publicly.

title: Kroger websites, mobile apps appear to be back online following reported outages
summary: Kroger's websites and mobile apps have reportedly returned online after experiencing outages on Friday. Although a banner indicated "intermittent site availability," the company apologized for the inconvenience. This service disruption occurred while Kroger is in court defending its proposed $24.6 billion merger with Albertsons against the Federal Trade Commission's attempts to block it.

title: Could Electricity for Bitcoin Mining Become Energy for AI?
summary: U.S. technology companies are increasingly acquiring energy assets from Bitcoin miners to power their rapidly growing AI and cloud computing data centers, leading to a surge in electricity demand. This shift is turning some crypto miners into energy providers for AI, with companies like Amazon purchasing facilities and others like Core Scientific leasing their power-connected infrastructure to AI firms. Experts predict that a significant portion of Bitcoin mining power capacity will transition to AI needs by 2027, highlighting a profitable new direction for the cryptocurrency mining industry.

title: SharkNinja Luxe Café Coffee Machine: Espresso, Cold Brew & Filter Coffee on Gadget Flow
summary: The SharkNinja Luxe Café Coffee Machine offers a versatile coffee experience at home, allowing users to create espresso, cold brew, and filtered coffee. It features temperature control, Barista Assist Technology for ideal settings, and various brewing options for different drink styles and sizes. The Gadget Flow team gave it a 9.3 rating, highlighting its ease, precision, and ability to deliver quality coffee.

title: 4 charts on the US rotation out of growth and tech stocks
summary: The article discusses the recent rotation in the US stock market, with investors shifting away from high-flying growth and tech stocks, particularly those tied to AI, towards value stocks in sectors like financials, healthcare, and consumer defensive. This shift is attributed to overvaluation in AI plays and attractive valuations in value and small-cap stocks, with economists foreseeing rate cuts and a soft landing. While major tech companies that led the market rally are now seeing declines, value stocks and defensive sectors are supporting the market's overall performance.

title: LiveOne to raise prices of its Plus, Premium subscription audio tiers
summary: LiveOne is increasing the prices of its Plus and Premium streaming music subscriptions to cover costs associated with new features and innovations, including leveraging artificial intelligence. The annual cost of LiveOne Plus will rise to $40 per year, and LiveOne Premium will increase to $11 per month, aligning with competitors like Spotify and Apple Music. CEO Robert Ellin believes AI will significantly improve user experience and help the company reach 10 million subscribers and $1 billion in revenue within five years.

title: IBM Gains 35% in the Past Year: Reason to Buy the Stock?
summary: IBM has seen a 35% gain over the past year, driven by strong demand for hybrid cloud and AI solutions, particularly through its partnership with Intel for Gaudi 3 AI accelerators and the Watsonx platform. Despite robust growth and strategic initiatives, the company faces stiff competition, margin pressures, and a premium valuation, leading Zacks Investment Research to recommend caution for new investors due to its Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

title: Salesforce CEO Reveals its ‘Next Big Transformation’
summary: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff announced that the company's "next big transformation" will be a "hard pivot" towards autonomous AI agents, with a new platform called ‘Agentforce’. This shift will be the centerpiece of their Dreamforce conference and a subsequent world tour, aiming to deploy AI agents for thousands of customers. Benioff is convinced that AI is the future of CRM despite skepticism from some analysts regarding the company's ability to deliver on these "game changing plans."

title: Nvidia Faces Investor Scrutiny Over Blackwell Chip Delays, Big Revenue Expected: Report
summary: Nvidia is facing investor scrutiny due to delays in its Blackwell chip rollout, despite expecting "several billion dollars" in revenue from it in the fiscal fourth quarter. The stock has dropped 15% since the announcement, though it remains up over 137% in the last 12 months. Analysts are concerned about the delays in the absence of other positive catalysts, while some argue the selloff is unwarranted given the strong demand for AI technology from Big Tech giants.

title: Hidden Roku trick gives you 200,000 free movies and TV shows plus 260 channels
summary: Roku and Amazon Fire TV users can access over 200,000 free movies and TV episodes, along with 260 live channels, through Tubi. This ad-supported streaming service has tied with Disney+ in hours watched, making it highly popular. Tubi continuously adds new content, including dedicated channels for popular TV shows and content from major networks like A&E and the History Channel.

title: Oracle Expands Multicloud Capabilities with AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure
summary: Oracle is significantly expanding its multicloud capabilities by collaborating with AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. This initiative allows customers to directly access Oracle Database services running on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure within the data centers of these major cloud providers. The offerings, including Oracle Database@AWS, Oracle Database@Azure, and Oracle Database@Google Cloud, aim to simplify cloud migration, enable multicloud deployments, and provide a unified experience for customers.

title: Global Payments CEO reshapes the business
summary: Global Payments is undergoing a significant transformation under CEO Cameron Bready, including U.S. job cuts, the acquisition of New York-based Yazara, and planned divestitures of non-core assets. The strategy aims to streamline the business, exit underperforming markets, and focus on core operations such as cloud modernization, ahead of an investor presentation this month. This restructuring follows previous job cuts earlier in the year and seeks to optimize the company's organizational structure and business strategy.

title: Hain Celestial launches two dairy products
summary: Hain Celestial Group introduced two new dairy products for the fall season: Greek Gods Honey Yogurt and Earth's Best Organic Immune Support Yogurt Smoothie. The company highlighted the indulgent nature of the honey yogurt and the immune-boosting benefits of the toddler-focused smoothie. These products are available at major retailers like Walmart, Amazon, and Target.

title: BlackRock Inc. Expands Stake in Repay Holdings Corp
summary: BlackRock Inc. significantly increased its stake in Repay Holdings Corp by acquiring an additional 733,419 shares on August 31, 2024, bringing its total holdings to 8,800,357 shares. This investment reflects BlackRock's strategic interest in the digital financial services sector, despite Repay Holdings Corp's current unprofitability and recent stock price decline, suggesting a long-term view on the growing digital payments industry.

title: Angel Studios to Become a Publicly Traded Company via Business Combination with Southport Acquisition Corporation
summary: Angel Studios announced its definitive agreement to become a publicly listed company through a business combination with Southport Acquisition Corporation (OTC: PORT). The transaction, which values the combined company at $1.6 billion, is expected to close in the first half of 2025 and will result in Angel Studios listing on the NYSE or Nasdaq under the ticker symbol “AGSD.” Angel Studios, known for community-driven content selection and successful films like *SOUND OF FREEDOM*, also plans to continue its Bitcoin treasury strategy.

title: Former Owner of Jeff Bezos' 'Billionaire Bunker' Estate Suing Realtor
summary: The former owner of a Miami Beach estate sold to Jeff Bezos is suing his realtor, Douglas Elliman, claiming he was misled about Bezos being the buyer. Leo Kryss alleges the realtor's CEO assured him Bezos was not the purchaser, causing Kryss to drop the asking price by $6 million. Kryss believes he lost out on this amount and is seeking damages, arguing he would not have agreed to the lower price if he had known Bezos was the actual buyer.

title: FedEx Launches Picture Proof of Delivery for Residential Deliveries in Malaysia
summary: FedEx has launched Picture Proof of Delivery (PPOD) for residential deliveries in Malaysia, a new service enhancement aimed at improving customer experience and supporting e-commerce growth. This service allows packages to be delivered without a signature, providing recipients with a photo of the package's exact location upon delivery. This initiative addresses the rising e-commerce market in Malaysia, projected to reach U.S. $13.43 billion by 2029, by offering enhanced reliability and peace of mind for both e-tailers and consumers.

title: Beyond Inc. chairman: “I see something totally different”
summary: Beyond Inc.'s chairman, Marcus Lemonis, revealed a new vision for the company's future, moving beyond a traditional retail model. He sees Beyond Inc. evolving into a holding company focused on monetizing intellectual property and consumer data, rather than solely selling goods. This strategic shift includes global licensing, expanding into physical retail via licensing agreements, and offering various home-related services to accumulate comprehensive consumer data to feed its IP and data monetization strategy.

title: Massive Microsoft data center brings new promise - and water and energy challenges - to Racine County.
summary: A new Microsoft data center in Racine County, spanning 1,347 acres, is under construction with a planned investment of $3.3 billion by 2026. While promising technological advancement, the project raises significant concerns regarding its substantial water and energy demands, and the limited number of new jobs it will create compared to the original Foxconn project. Local officials, including Racine Mayor Cory Mason, express anxieties about potential environmental impacts and the exacerbation of socioeconomic disparities in the region.

title: Sponsored Content: A New Path to Financial Mobility
summary: This article discusses the importance of increasing access to credit for financial mobility and economic growth, featuring an interview with Brian Doubles, President and CEO of Synchrony. Synchrony's approach involves using advanced underwriting capabilities and diverse data points to serve consumers with limited or no credit history, thereby promoting financial inclusion. The company's efforts also support small and mid-sized businesses and address challenges like the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau's late fee rule.

title: Kroger ‘committed to closing the merger’ with Albertsons
summary: Kroger CEO Rodney McMullen reiterated the company's commitment to the $24.6 billion merger with Albertsons, despite ongoing litigation and regulatory scrutiny from the Federal Trade Commission. He expressed confidence in the deal's benefits for customers, associates, and communities, while also stating Kroger is prepared to move forward even if regulators block the transaction. The article also covers Kroger's flattish Q2 performance and the strategic rationale behind the merger, aiming to compete with larger retailers.

title: Kroger zeroes in on customer experience to build loyalty and sales
summary: Kroger is focusing on enhancing its customer experience through in-store improvements and convenient digital delivery options, leading to increased sales and customer loyalty. The grocer achieved a 33% year-over-year improvement in "perfect orders" and is leveraging AI and associate investments to speed up order fulfillment. These CX investments are helping to grow its loyalty program membership and drive long-term sales, even as it faces regulatory scrutiny over its planned merger with Albertsons.

title: Jacobs Solutions announces record date and distribution date for the spin-off of its Critical Mission Solutions and Cyber & Intelligence Government Services businesses
summary: Jacobs Solutions has announced the record date of September 23, 2024, and the distribution date of September 27, 2024, for the spin-off of its Critical Mission Solutions and Cyber & Intelligence government services businesses. These businesses will merge with Amentum to form a new publicly traded company, Amentum Holdings, Inc., in which Jacobs' shareholders will initially own 51% and Jacobs will retain a 7.5% stake. The transaction is expected to create two distinct companies with clear strategies for long-term value creation.

title: Why investors park billions in high-fee legacy ETFs
summary: This article explores why investors continue to allocate billions of dollars to high-fee legacy ETFs, even when lower-cost alternatives are available from the same asset managers. It delves into various reasons, including non-fee considerations like tax advantages, replication costs, and liquidity, as well as investor inertia and the specific use cases for niche or tactical exposures where trading costs or fund size might outweigh annual fees. The article highlights that while fees are important, other factors often explain these investment decisions.

title: Intel and AWS Expand Strategic Collaboration, Helping Advance U.S.-Based Chip Manufacturing
summary: Intel and AWS announced a significant expansion of their strategic collaboration, involving a multi-year, multi-billion-dollar co-investment in custom chip designs. Intel will produce an AI fabric chip on Intel 18A and a custom Xeon 6 chip on Intel 3 for AWS, accelerating U.S.-based semiconductor manufacturing and fostering a vibrant AI ecosystem in Ohio.

title: Pat Gelsinger on Foundry Momentum, Progress on Plan
summary: Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger outlined the next phase of Intel's transformation following a Board of Directors meeting. Key takeaways include building on Foundry momentum, driving cost efficiencies to achieve a $10B savings target, and refocusing on the x86 franchise with an AI strategy. The company announced an expanded strategic collaboration with AWS for custom chip designs, a $3B award under the CHIPS and Science Act for the U.S. Secure Enclave program, and plans to establish Intel Foundry as an independent subsidiary.

title: How to invest in Artificial Intelligence (AI)
summary: This article explores various ways to invest in Artificial Intelligence (AI), including ETFs, leading tech companies, and smaller innovative firms, while also highlighting potential risks such as market volatility and ethical concerns. It provides a list of top AI stocks and emphasizes the importance of research and diversification for investors looking to capitalize on this transformative technology. The piece concludes by suggesting professional financial advice to navigate AI investment complexities effectively.

title: SNL Comedian Fineman Promotes Ninja Luxe Café Coffee System
summary: SharkNinja, Inc. has partnered with Saturday Night Live star Chloe Fineman to promote the new Ninja Luxe Café coffee system. Fineman celebrated the launch at Ninja's "House of Vibes" immersive experience in New York City and stars in a social media series showcasing the product's versatility. The Ninja Luxe Café offers barista-quality espresso, drip coffee, and rapid cold brew with Barista Assist Technology and a hands-free Dual Froth System.

title: Pacer MSCI World Industry Advantage ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (BATS:GLBL)
summary: The Pacer MSCI World Industry Advantage ETF (GLBL) is an exchange-traded fund that invests in total market equity from leading countries, tracking an index that selects securities with the highest active weight in GICS Industry Groups. The ETF was launched on September 16, 2024, and its stock has seen a 6.8% increase since the beginning of 2026, trading at $26.90. Its top holdings include major tech companies like Amazon.com, NVIDIA, Microsoft, Apple, and Alphabet.

title: Big tech firms balk at Ohio electric utility demand to pay for grid upgrades
summary: Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and Meta are resisting demands from an Ohio utility, American Electric Power Ohio, to pay for electric grid upgrades needed to support their energy-intensive AI data centers. The utility argues these payments are necessary to prevent costs from being passed on to consumers, while the tech firms deem the proposed tariff "unfair" and "discriminatory." A hearing is scheduled for October 30 to address the dispute, which highlights the increasing energy demands of AI technology and the associated infrastructure costs.

title: Amazon CEO calls workers back to the office 5 days a week
summary: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy is mandating that workers return to the office five days a week. This decision could significantly impact downtown Seattle's recovery, where office worker volumes have remained at approximately 60% of pre-Covid levels.

title: Amazon CEO Vows Leaner Teams Amid Bloat, Ends Work From Home
summary: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy is initiating a corporate shakeup to streamline operations, reduce bureaucracy, and cut management layers. This includes requiring employees to return to the office five days a week starting in January, a move aimed at enhancing productivity and collaboration within the company. The decision comes amidst concerns from veterans about increasing internal hurdles and inefficiencies at Amazon.

title: Talkspace Goes Retail, Partners with Amazon’s Health Business
summary: Digital mental health provider Talkspace Inc. is now selling its services on Amazon through Amazon Health Services’ Health Conditions Programs, becoming the first virtual behavioral health provider to participate. This partnership aims to make mental health care more accessible to a wider audience, building on Talkspace's B2B growth strategy. The announcement led to a modest bump in Talkspace's stock price, which traded at $2.21 per share, up 21% in the past week, though down 7% year to date.

title: Asana Appoints Josh Abdulla as Head of Customer Experience
summary: Asana, Inc. (NYSE:ASAN)(LTSE:ASAN) announced the appointment of Josh Abdulla as Head of Customer Experience. Abdulla, who previously served as Chief Customer Officer at LiveRamp, will oversee Asana's customer success, professional services, and support teams, reporting to Chief Revenue Officer Ed McDonnell. His role will focus on driving customer adoption, ensuring maximum value from the Asana platform for its 150,000+ customers, and expanding the company's enterprise footprint.

title: U.S. utility solar market has grown 34% since Q2 2023
summary: The U.S. utility-scale solar market experienced significant growth, with a 34% increase in installed capacity since Q2 2023, totaling over 110,000 MW. Despite this record growth driven by the Inflation Reduction Act, challenges like permitting, interconnection delays, and tariffs are slowing project development and increasing costs. Developers are adapting through strategic supply chain management and focusing on large-scale projects, with Texas leading in new installations.

title: Signals from Salesforce: Data integration and gen AI in focus
summary: Salesforce is leveraging enhanced data integration and generative AI to unite its previously disparate platforms, aiming for a more cohesive presence in the enterprise software market. Analysts Christophe Bertrand and John Furrier from theCUBE Research discussed at Dreamforce 2024 how this strategy helps Salesforce overcome its reputation for fragmented systems by using gen AI as a "glue layer" to simplify workflows, improve operational efficiency, and enhance developer engagement. The integration also brings a focus on data protection and cybersecurity, underscored by Salesforce's collaboration with cloud providers and recent acquisitions like OwnBackup.

title: Kroger and Albertsons prepare to make a final federal court argument for their merger
summary: Kroger and Albertsons are preparing for their final federal court argument regarding their proposed $24.6 billion merger. The Federal Trade Commission (FTC) is seeking a preliminary injunction to block the deal, arguing it would harm consumers through higher prices and reduced competition, while the companies contend the merger would enable them to lower prices and better compete with retail giants. Several states have also filed lawsuits against the merger, and a Colorado trial is set to begin in late September.

title: Portland judge considers fate of the Kroger-Albertsons supermarket mega-merger
summary: A federal judge in Portland heard closing arguments in the proposed $25 billion merger between Kroger and Albertsons, which would create the largest supermarket company in U.S. history. The Federal Trade Commission, joined by eight states including Oregon, argues the merger would reduce competition, harm workers, and raise prices, while Kroger contends it would allow for reduced prices and better competition against large retailers. The judge is expected to make a decision soon in a case that has drawn national attention due to concerns about inflation and grocery costs.

title: Inside closing arguments from the FTC’s challenge to Kroger-Albertsons merger
summary: Closing arguments in the FTC's challenge to the Kroger-Albertsons merger concluded, with both sides presenting their cases to a federal judge. The FTC argued the merger would harm local competition and that the divestiture plan was insufficient, while Kroger and Albertsons contended the merger is necessary to compete with industry giants and would benefit consumers through lower prices and a stronger C&S Wholesale Grocers. The judge will issue a decision on a preliminary injunction at a later date.

title: Here's What's Going On With That Class-Action Lawsuit Against MrBeast And Amazon
summary: MrBeast and Amazon are facing a class-action lawsuit filed by five unnamed contestants of the "Beast Games" reality competition show. The lawsuit, filed in Los Angeles Superior Court, alleges chronic mistreatment, sexual harassment, emotional distress, unpaid wages, and dangerous working conditions. Contestants claim they were denied adequate hygiene, medical care, and suffered injuries, with female contestants reportedly enduring a misogynistic and sexist environment.

title: Spectrum Reach Makes Ad Deal With Amazon to Give Local Business Access to More Streaming Inventory
summary: Spectrum Reach, Charter Communications' ad-sales arm, has partnered with Amazon to become a local reseller of Amazon Ads, including inventory on Prime Video, Freevee, and Fire TV. This agreement allows Spectrum Reach to offer small and local businesses expanded streaming ad campaigns alongside linear inventory, enabling them to reach a broader audience within their service regions. The collaboration aims to simplify media fragmentation and provide businesses with better tools to measure and optimize their advertising spend using Amazon Ads' capabilities and Spectrum Reach's first-party data.

title: Amazon Boosts Warehouse Worker Pay By at Least $1.50 an Hour
summary: Amazon.com Inc. is increasing the hourly wages for its warehouse workers by a minimum of $1.50, effective this month, which will elevate the average base wage to over $22 per hour. Additionally, the company will include Prime memberships as a new benefit for these employees. This pay increase is happening as employees continue to face inflationary pressures on their earnings.

title: Progyny’s stock slides 31% after company discloses loss of key client
summary: Progyny Inc.'s stock experienced a significant 31% drop, its largest-ever one-day decline, following the announcement that a major client had terminated its agreement. This client represented about 670,000 members and contributed 12% to the company's revenue in the first half of the year and 13% in fiscal year 2023. Analysts suspect the client in question is Amazon.

title: FedEx Cuts Forecast After Tough Quarter for Deliveries
summary: FedEx Corp. cut its full-year profit outlook and reported lower-than-expected quarterly earnings due to softer demand for package deliveries and customers opting for cheaper shipping options. The CEO cited a challenging quarter, leading to a significant drop in FedEx's shares, and the company expects adjusted earnings for the current fiscal year to be $20 to $21 a share, below its previous forecast. Despite this, FedEx remains on track for $2.2 billion in savings this fiscal year as it integrates its delivery networks.

title: Survey: Nearly one-third of consumers have thrifted in past year
summary: A new survey from Savers Value Village reveals that nearly one-third of consumers have thrifted in the past year, with 90% of American and Canadian consumers engaging with thrift stores. In-person shopping dominates secondhand sales, and thrifting extends beyond apparel to categories like books and home decor. The trend is particularly strong among Gen Z, who often integrate secondhand items into more than a quarter of their wardrobe.

title: CarMax CEO William Nash joins eBay board of directors
summary: eBay Inc. has appointed William D. Nash, President and CEO of CarMax, to its board of directors, effective September 18, 2024. Nash brings extensive experience in retail and e-commerce, building customer loyalty, and growing businesses. His expertise is expected to help eBay further its strategy and focus on sustainable, long-term growth.

title: Nearly 138,000 Beds Recalled Because They Can Collapse During Use
summary: CVB Inc. has recalled nearly 138,000 Lucid-branded platform beds due to reports of them breaking or collapsing, leading to 18 injuries. The recalled beds were sold between September 2019 and April 2024 at various retailers. Consumers are advised to stop using the beds and can receive a free replacement bed frame by emailing a photo of the support rails with "recalled" written on them.

title: Amazon Wants to Kill the Dreaded Meeting to Discuss the Meeting
summary: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy is targeting excessive meetings, specifically "pre-meetings for the pre-meetings for the decision meetings," to reduce corporate bureaucracy. This initiative aims to streamline operations and potentially save large firms significant amounts of money annually, making Amazon the latest major company to address workplace inefficiencies.

title: Kroger SWOT Analysis (2025)
summary: This article provides a comprehensive SWOT analysis of Kroger for 2025, examining its internal strengths and weaknesses, as well as external opportunities and threats. It highlights Kroger's extensive product range, strong brand, and financial performance as strengths, while noting weaknesses like limited international presence and vulnerability to cybersecurity threats. The analysis also identifies opportunities in e-commerce and private label expansion, alongside threats from intense competition and shifting consumer preferences.

title: Amazon.com, Inc.
summary: The International Trade Union Confederation (ITUC) accuses Amazon of posing a significant threat to democracy, citing its union-busting activities, low wages, e-commerce monopoly, carbon emissions, tax evasion, and extensive lobbying. The article details instances of Amazon challenging labor laws globally and promoting far-right politics through funding and platforming. ITUC highlights Amazon's transformation into a security and war contractor, further criticizing its disregard for democratic scrutiny and human rights.

title: One of America’s most iconic retail chains, Kmart, set to close last full-size store in US
summary: Kmart is closing its last full-size store in the US, located in Bridgehampton, NY, on October 20th, reducing the once-vast chain to a single smaller store in Miami within the continental US. This closure marks a significant decline for the iconic retailer, which once boasted over 2,000 locations, and highlights its struggles against competitors like Walmart and Amazon, despite past partnerships with figures like Martha Stewart and attempts at revival by investors like Eddie Lampert. Kmart's origins trace back to 1899, with its peak in the 1990s before eventual bankruptcies and acquisitions.

title: Report: Apollo Global Management Offers $5 Billion Investment in Intel
summary: Apollo Global Management has reportedly offered Intel a $5 billion investment, which Intel executives are currently considering. This potential investment could serve as an alternative to a possible takeover by rival chipmaker Qualcomm, which recently initiated discussions with Intel regarding an acquisition. Both Intel's declining sales and Qualcomm's regulatory challenges are key factors in these ongoing negotiations.

title: Artificial Intelligence and Adaptive Portfolio Management
summary: This article highlights a podcast episode from Investor Insights that explores the role of Artificial Intelligence in adaptive portfolio management. The discussion emphasizes AI as a tool to enhance human expertise in creating sophisticated investment applications and evolving portfolio strategies from traditional "buy and hold" approaches. It concludes that investors need to understand AI's implications for portfolio management, even if they don't grasp its technical intricacies.

title: Commvault To Boost AWS Capabilities With $47 Million Clumio Purchase
summary: Commvault is set to acquire AWS-focused cloud data protection vendor Clumio for approximately $47 million, a move expected to enhance Commvault's cyber resilience offerings and strengthen its SaaS platform, particularly for AWS environments. This acquisition is anticipated to immediately boost Commvault's annual recurring revenue and contribute to free cash flow within three quarters. Clumio's founders, Poojan Kumar and Woon Jung, will join Commvault, integrating Clumio's AWS expertise with Commvault's broader data protection portfolio.

title: Microsoft announces $1.3 billion USD investment in Cloud and AI infrastructure supporting inclusive growth through technology and skilling programs in Mexico
summary: Microsoft is investing $1.3 billion over three years in Mexico to enhance its Cloud and AI infrastructure and promote digital and AI skills, aiming to train 5 million people. This initiative, announced by CEO Satya Nadella, will increase local computing capacity, foster innovation, support digital transformation for small and medium-sized businesses, and address societal challenges in health, connectivity, and sustainability. The investment reinforces Microsoft's commitment to Mexico's inclusive economic growth and reflects its role in making AI widely accessible and beneficial.

title: Spotify expands AI Playlist feature to four new markets, including U.S. and Canada
summary: Spotify is expanding its AI Playlist feature for premium users to four new markets, including the United States and Canada. This tool, currently in beta, allows subscribers to create personalized song selections using generative AI and text prompts. The expansion aims to attract new subscribers and enhance the app's features amidst competition from Apple and Amazon.

title: Artificial intelligence to drive future U.S. natural gas demand, EQT CEO predicts
summary: The CEO of EQT Corp. predicts that artificial intelligence and data centers will be the largest new driver of U.S. natural gas demand in the coming years. This surge in demand could lead to increased price volatility, despite current oversupply. EQT is positioned to meet this demand, particularly in regions with existing infrastructure, highlighting the potential for significant shifts in energy markets.

title: NetApp Powers the Future of AI with Intelligent Data Infrastructure
summary: NetApp announced new developments in its collaboration with industry leaders to accelerate AI innovation, providing the intelligent data infrastructure required for GenAI. Key innovations include NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD Storage Certification for NetApp ONTAP, a global metadata namespace, directly integrated AI data pipeline, and a disaggregated storage architecture. NetApp is also expanding its ecosystem collaborations with companies like Domino Data Labs and Lenovo to further integrate and optimize AI workflows.

title: PTC Announces Strategic Collaboration Agreement with AWS to Help Companies Design Products Faster and Easier with Onshape
summary: PTC announced a Strategic Collaboration Agreement (SCA) with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to accelerate the growth of its Onshape cloud-native CAD and PDM solution. This partnership will focus on enhancing Onshape's product features, customer adoption, and AI initiatives, aiming to help designers create products faster and more efficiently. Key initiatives include the Onshape Discovery Program, Onshape AI Advisor, enhanced CAD and PDM conversion tools, and a new Onshape Government option for elevated security requirements.

title: Nashville's growing health care industry nabs $3M corporate expansion
summary: Harrow, an eyecare pharmaceutical company, is expanding its corporate headquarters in Nashville with a $3 million investment, adding 147 new jobs. The state's Economic and Community Development department incentivized this expansion, highlighting Nashville's appeal for businesses, particularly in the healthcare sector. Speakers at the announcement emphasized Nashville's potential to become a healthcare epicenter and its strong job market.

title: Payments firm Payoneer to adopt localised approach for expanding user base in India
summary: Payments firm Payoneer plans to expand its user base in India by adopting a localized approach and leveraging its global marketplace partnerships. The company aims to capitalize on India's rapidly growing service export market, focusing on sectors like tech, digital marketing, SaaS, and e-commerce. Payoneer has seen impressive customer and revenue growth in India, highlighting the country's strategic importance for the Nasdaq-listed firm.

title: NetApp redefining hyperscaler partnerships for AI storage
summary: NetApp is strategically partnering with major hyperscalers like Amazon, Microsoft, and Google to redefine enterprise storage, focusing on AI storage, hybrid cloud data management, and enhanced security. This approach allows NetApp to offer global availability and integrate its ONTAP capabilities with hyperscaler AI tools, ensuring customers have secure and compliant access to advanced technologies without data complexity. The partnerships aim to provide enterprises with greater flexibility and infrastructure control in a rapidly evolving technological landscape.

title: Commvault acquisition of Clumio for S3 speaks volumes
summary: Commvault acquired Clumio for $47 million to enhance its Commvault Cloud platform, specifically in Amazon S3 object storage workloads, and gain access to a rapidly growing market segment. This acquisition, along with Appranix earlier in the year, signifies Commvault's strategy to deepen its capabilities within AWS and address complex cloud data workloads, reflecting broader trends in the data protection and recovery markets. The deal highlights the ongoing investment momentum in the data backup and recovery industry, particularly in high-growth cloud and cyber recovery services.

title: Why We Believe Gold Stocks Are the Hidden Opportunity in 2024’s Bull Market
summary: Frank Holmes argues that gold stocks represent a hidden opportunity in 2024's bull market despite gold hitting new all-time highs. He highlights that central bank monetary easing, record central bank gold purchases, and the undervaluation of gold mining stocks relative to bullion prices make them an attractive investment. U.S. Global Investors' Gold and Precious Metals Fund (USERX) is presented as a strong option to capitalize on this trend, actively managing a portfolio of senior gold producers.

title: Kraft Heinz brings procurement expertise to Rise Against Hunger
summary: Kraft Heinz is leveraging its procurement expertise and logistics network to support Rise Against Hunger, aiming to double the nonprofit's global meal donation program by 2027. Through the Kraft Heinz Rise Together Procurement Program, the company commits $15 million and partners with global suppliers and logistics companies like Maersk to deliver nutritional products to communities in need, including those in Ukraine, Turkiye, and Syria. This initiative has already delivered over 20 truckloads of food valued at approximately $500,000 in 2023.

title: Nordstrom veteran joins eBay as chief comms officer
summary: Gigi Ganatra Duff, a Nordstrom veteran, has been appointed as eBay's new chief communications officer. Reporting to Chief Growth Officer Julie Loeger, Duff will lead global communications, including internal, external, social media, public affairs, and ESG communications. Her extensive experience in corporate affairs and communications is expected to bring fresh energy and innovation to eBay during its current transformation.

title: Salesforce Agentforce AI and insights from Dreamforce
summary: This article explores three key insights from Dreamforce '24, focusing on Salesforce's ambitious plans around automation and the new Salesforce Agentforce AI. Discussions from TheCUBE analysts Christophe Bertrand and John Furrier, alongside Salesforce executives, highlight how generative AI and agentic systems are set to transform Salesforce into a "mega giant" by integrating seamlessly into business workflows and enhancing customer solutions through strategic partnerships. The article emphasizes data utilization, advanced automation, and the company's evolution beyond its traditional CRM platform.

title: InterDigital, IBD Stock Of The Day, Flirts With Buy Point After Analyst Day
summary: InterDigital (IDCC) has been named IBD Stock Of The Day and is approaching a buy point of 140.60 after an analyst day. The stock has a Composite Rating of 95/99 and is forming a shallow flat base. The article also mentions widespread investment in AI stocks by major tech companies.

title: THE FRIDAY 5: New Leader at Stop & Shop; Kroger Prepares for 3rd Court Battle
summary: This article covers the top five food retail industry news items, including Roger Wheeler's new leadership role at Stop & Shop, Kroger's ongoing court battles regarding its merger with Albertsons, a potential port strike impacting the U.S. food supply chain, Whole Foods' research into Gen Z consumer preferences, and Weis Markets' expansion in Pennsylvania through an acquisition.

title: Three ways Private AI puts organisations in the driving seat for innovation
summary: The article explains how Private AI can help organizations innovate by addressing concerns about data control, regulatory compliance, and vendor lock-in. It highlights three key benefits: unparalleled levels of control over data and models, ease of navigating the evolving regulatory landscape, and futureproofing tech infrastructures to avoid vendor lock-in. Private AI enables businesses to maximize AI potential while safeguarding their data and supporting local economies.

title: IonQ Announces $54.5 Million Contract with United States Air Force Research Lab
summary: IonQ has secured a $54.5 million contract with the U.S. Air Force Research Lab (AFRL) to advance quantum networking, bringing its year-to-date bookings to $72.8 million. This partnership aims to scale, network, and deploy quantum systems, building on IonQ's consistent revenue growth since its 2021 IPO. The company also recently extended contracts with Amazon Web Services and the University of Maryland, demonstrating strong expansion in both government and enterprise sectors.

title: American Eagle’s Suit Against Amazon Puts ‘Dupe Culture’ in the Spotlight
summary: American Eagle has filed a lawsuit against Amazon, alleging that the e-commerce giant manipulated trademark branding for its Aerie and Offline by Aerie lines to mislead online shoppers into buying "inferior quality knock-offs" from third-party sellers. This legal action highlights the growing issue of "dupe culture," where copycat products are widely available online and consumers, particularly Gen Z and millennials, increasingly seek these more affordable alternatives. The suit brings into focus the distinction between counterfeit goods, which aim to deceive, and dupes, which are presented as accessible homages.

title: Why Is IonQ Stock Trading Higher On Friday?
summary: IonQ (NYSE: IONQ) shares are trading higher on Friday after the company signed a $54.5 million contract with the United States Air Force Research Lab. The quantum computing company has reported $72.8 million in bookings year-to-date and is confident about meeting or exceeding its annual guidance. This positive news follows other recent deals, including a quantum networking contract with ARLIS and a $9 million agreement with the University of Maryland.

title: Betting On China As It Brings Out The Big Guns
summary: China has announced expanded stimulus measures, including ¥2 trillion in government bonds and ¥1 trillion into state-owned banks, signaling a significant economic push. This article outlines four specific stock bets in the Chinese market—Qifu Technology, X Financial, Hello Group Inc., and PDD Holdings Inc.—that are positioned to benefit from this "bazooka moment" of stimulus. Investors are advised to consider the potential half-life of these interventions, as suggested by ZeroHedge.

title: AI Mania in Fine Fettle: ETFs to Invest
summary: The article discusses the resurgence of AI investment fervor on Wall Street, driven by strong performances from companies like Micron and significant investments from tech giants such as Microsoft and Amazon. It highlights how these developments are boosting the AI sector and suggests several AI-focused ETFs, including BOTZ, ROBT, and WISE, for investors looking to capitalize on this trend. The piece also touches upon NVIDIA's fluctuating valuation and its central role in the AI infrastructure.

title: Big problems for big furniture store chain with 14 NJ locations
summary: Bob's Discount Furniture is facing significant online problems, including a network disruption that began on Thursday and escalated by Friday. Although their physical stores remain open for business, customers expecting deliveries are advised to check emails for updates, as the company cannot provide real-time information or adjustments. The issue has also made it impossible to contact the company via phone, affecting its 14 New Jersey, 16 Pennsylvania, and 180 nationwide locations.

title: Intuit embraces LLM choice for multiple use cases
summary: Intuit is using its Generative AI Operating System (GenOS) to allow its developers to select from up to 10 large language models for various consumer and business applications across its platforms like TurboTax and QuickBooks. This strategy provides redundancy and flexibility, enabling Intuit to leverage a unified data and AI platform to solve customer problems and future-proof its AI capabilities as the landscape evolves. Intuit has also introduced AI Workbench within GenOS, offering tools like an LLM Leaderboard and an LLM sandbox with various models including Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta Llama.

title: KT strikes multibillion-dollar AI deal with Microsoft
summary: South Korean telco KT Corp. has formed a five-year strategic partnership with Microsoft, valued at billions of dollars, to collaboratively develop AI and cloud services for both the Korean market and international needs. This deal includes a $450 million usage fee for Microsoft to utilize KT and KT Cloud infrastructure. The partnership will focus on customized AI model development, a secure sovereign cloud platform, and establishing an AI transformation company, alongside fostering the domestic AI ecosystem.

title: The Beachbody Company Evolves Core Business Model with Updated Omnichannel Approach Focused on Accelerating Path to Profitable Growth
summary: The Beachbody Company (BODi) is revamping its core business model to an omnichannel approach, moving from Multi-Level Marketing (MLM) to a single-level Affiliate Program and expanding direct-to-consumer and Amazon channels. This restructuring is expected to significantly reduce costs, lower the revenue break-even point by approximately 47% to under $225 million, and includes a 33% workforce reduction for $54 million in annualized savings. BODi reaffirms its Q3 2024 financial guidance while anticipating this shift will accelerate its path to profitable growth.

title: Goldman Sachs Reiterates Buy Rating on Jabil (JBL)
summary: Goldman Sachs has reiterated a Buy rating on Jabil (NYSE: JBL) with a $136.00 price target, following the company's Q4 FY24 earnings report. Despite a mixed report with FY25 EBIT guidance modestly below the Street, Goldman Sachs believes Jabil's repositioned business mix, focusing on favorable end markets like datacenter, auto, industrial, renewables, and medical, will drive long-term growth. The firm also notes Jabil's investments in these areas, addition of new hyperscale customers, and supportive capital allocation as reasons to maintain a positive outlook.

title: Sony Pictures CEO Tony Vinciquerra to step down, succeeded by Ravi Ahuja
summary: Tony Vinciquerra, the current Chairman and CEO of Sony Pictures Entertainment, will step down in January 2025, handing over the reins to Ravi Ahuja. Ahuja, who previously ran Sony’s global television studios and has a background with Disney and Fox, was promoted to COO in April, signaling this succession. Vinciquerra is credited with turning Sony Pictures into a profitable "arms dealer" in the streaming wars by producing content for various platforms rather than launching its own

title: Amazon draws more ad commitments than expected, in positive news for stock
summary: Amazon Prime Video secured over $1.8 billion in advertising commitments during its recent upfront event, surpassing its internal targets and putting it on track for up to $4 billion in ad revenue in 2025. This performance significantly outpaces rival Netflix, according to Bank of America analysts. Analysts believe this success is positive news for Amazon's stock.

title: Amazon draws more ad commitments than expected, in positive news for stock
summary: Amazon Prime Video significantly exceeded its advertising commitment targets, securing over $1.8 billion at its recent upfront event, which Bank of America considers positive news for Amazon's stock. This performance positions Prime Video to potentially achieve up to $4 billion in ad revenue by 2025, putting it ahead of rivals like Netflix. BofA analysts noted this strong showing suggests robust growth in Amazon's streaming ad business.

title: NBXG: Deep Discount, Attractive Yield On This Technology Fund With A Termination Date
summary: The Neuberger Berman Next Generation Connectivity Fund (NBXG) is highlighted as an attractive investment due to its focus on tech and communications, appealing 12%+ discount, and activist involvement. The fund also offers a strong yield through its managed monthly distribution plan and features a limited-term structure with a termination date in 2033. This combination, along with improved recent performance and strong Quant Profitability Grades for top holdings, suggests potential for capturing alpha.

title: CVS is working with advisors on strategic review, sources say
summary: CVS Health's board has engaged advisors to conduct a strategic review of its business amid potential activist pressure and a depressed stock price. One option being considered is a break up of the insurance and retail businesses. The company is facing challenges such as heightened medical costs in its insurance unit and declining sales in its retail segment due to inflation, softer consumer spending, and competition.

title: Focus: MercadoLibre, Latam's Amazon.com rival, rides high with AI, loans, drones
summary: MercadoLibre, Latin America's e-commerce giant, is expanding rapidly by leveraging AI, offering loans, and exploring drone delivery to enhance its ecosystem for shoppers and sellers. The company is using its extensive user data to provide instant credit, fueling its growth and solidifying its position as the region's most valuable firm despite competition from other fintechs. Investors are bullish on MercadoLibre's outlook, with strong growth in areas like credit and plans to triple active users.
